question: Should experimental Claw lifecycle ownership be accepted as a core Doctor contribution and landed as part of the stacked Claws sequence?
rationale: The implementation is an opt-in new core lifecycle and diagnostics surface, while its required ownership model is still supplied by an open parent PR; code review cannot decide whether that product direction belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor the staged experimental surface
options.body: Approve the Claws ownership stack as a core experimental direction, land its parent first, and require the small gate-documentation correction before this PR merges.

options.title: Keep the work at RFC stage
options.body: Defer this Doctor integration until maintainers decide that the Claws lifecycle model should become a supported core experimental surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged experimental surface
recommendation.body: Approve the Claws ownership stack as a core experimental direction, land its parent first, and require the small gate-documentation correction before this PR merges.

likelyOwner.reason: The stack explicitly brought this person into the discussion, making them the best available routing candidate for the remaining core product decision.
